registered_before_run: Day 21 - written before Day 22's arms are trained or evaluated
task: binary patch classifier: does an 8x8 EMPS patch contain particle pixels (from the real segmap) or is it pure background
model: single-hidden-layer MLP (small, CPU-trainable), trained with plain SGD

arms.c_real_plus_synthetic: TRAIN-split patches + patches from images generated by sample_coarse_to_fine, generated ONLY from TRAIN sources (never VALIDATION or TEST)

equal_update_budget.rule: identical total_gradient_steps, batch_size, optimizer and learning_rate across all three arms - no exceptions, per spec rule 14

held_out_evaluation_set.rule: no generator or training arm may touch these groups - enforced by data.guard.assert_lineage_avoids_holdout, tested against a deliberately contaminated record
held_out_evaluation_set.bootstrap_unit: group (DOI), never patch or image - per spec rule 8

pre_registered_thresholds.benefit_definition: arm C's mean held-out bootstrap accuracy must exceed arm A's by at least this many percentage points to be called a benefit
pre_registered_thresholds.harm_definition: if arm C's mean held-out bootstrap accuracy falls more than this many percentage points BELOW arm A's, the synthetic arm is classified as harmful, regardless of arm B's result
pre_registered_thresholds.note: a benefit margin without a harm tolerance would let synthetic data only ever look good - both are pre-registered together, per spec
